title: Newbuild Project Manager
description:
DescriptionAt Ocean Infinity, we're using technology to transform operations at sea, making them safer, more efficient, and more sustainable.We're a team of innovators, problem-solvers, and challengers who believe there is always a better way. If you're ambitious, collaborative, and excited by the opportunity to create meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.Join us and help shape the future.Ocean Infinity is seeking a highly motivated and experienced New Build Project Manager to lead critical projects within our Robotics Asset Delivery Department. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of delivering new build projects to time, budget, and scope, with a keen understanding of managing dependencies within a broader programme context. This role requires excellent organisational skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse, distributed teams and stakeholders.What you will do:Project Planning & Execution:Plan, execute, and close projects within assigned programmes, adhering to established methodologies and Transformation Office governance frameworks. Develop detailed project plans, including scope definition, dependencies, resource allocation, and realistic timelines. Define and manage project budgets, track expenditure, and ensure projects are delivered within financial constraints. Monitor project progress, identify deviations from the plan, and implement corrective actions as needed. Champion the adoption of technology and AI to aid delivery, introducing efficiencies and use to add control to day-to-day delivery. Stakeholder Management:Build and maintain strong working relationships with project stakeholders, including internal teams, vendors, and external partners. Communicate project status, risks, and issues effectively to the Programme Manager and relevant stakeholders. Facilitate workshops and meetings to drive project progress and resolve issues. Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage project-level risks and issues, developing mitigation strategies. Escalate critical issues to the Programme Manager in a timely manner, providing clear recommendations for resolution alongside other options considered. Quality & Change Management:Ensure project deliverables meet defined quality standards and stakeholder expectations. Manage project change requests, assessing their impact on scope, schedule, and budget, and securing necessary approvals. Reporting & Documentation:Prepare and submit regular project reports, providing accurate and timely updates on progress, budget, and risks. Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, meeting minutes, and decision logs. Ensure project closure activities are completed efficiently, including lessons learned and handover of deliverables. RequirementsWho you are:5+ years of experience as a Project Manager of projects within complex, large-scale Programmes of work. Demonstrable experience managing multiple projects simultaneously within a programme framework.  Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall), and tools.  Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, and resources effectively.  Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across various teams.  Proactive problem-solver with a strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.  Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  Experience in the marine, engineering, technology, or other similarly complex industries is highly desirable.  Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Agile PM, PRINCE2, CSM) are highly advantageous.  Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Engineering, Project Management) or equivalent practical experience. BenefitsSalary for this position: Up to £75,000 per annum

title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.ABOUT THE TEAMImmuta’s Customer Success team helps customers realize measurable value from Immuta’s Data Authorization Platform, enabling them to provision governed access to data safely and at scale. We partner closely with customers and internal teams to drive adoption, strengthen outcomes, and build long-term relationships that support retention and growth.Across EMEA, the team works with organizations operating in complex, multi-country environments. We bring together customer empathy, technical fluency, and regional awareness to help customers navigate data governance, privacy, security, and data residency requirements while advancing their business goals.ABOUT THE ROLEAs a Senior Customer Success Manager for the EMEA region, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers across the region. You’ll guide customers through onboarding, implementation, adoption, optimization, and renewal, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes with Immuta’s Data Authorization Platform.You’ll partner with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and executives to define success plans, demonstrate value, manage risks, and identify opportunities to expand the customer relationship. This is a high-impact role for a customer-focused professional who combines strategic relationship management with enough technical depth to engage in complex data and cloud environments.This is a full-time, remote role for candidates located in the greater London, UK area. The role reports to the VP of Customer Success. Travel may be required according to the needs of the business.CORE RESPONSIBILITIESPartner with senior customer stakeholders to define desired outcomes, establish success measures, and build actionable adoption roadmaps.Lead onboarding, deployment, and integration programs across modern data platforms and cloud environments, coordinating internal and customer teams to support successful implementation.Manage enterprise customer relationships across EMEA through the full customer lifecycle, including adoption, value realization, renewal planning, and expansion.Monitor account health, value, strengthen adoption, and align stakeholders on next steps.Advise customers on data governance, access control, privacy, security, and applicable regional requirements, including GDPR and data residency considerations.Collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and technical delivery teams to resolve blockers, align customer needs with Immuta’s roadmap, and deliver a consistent customer experience.Capture customer feedback, implementation patterns, and market insights to inform product improvements and strengthen customer success practices.Identify opportunities for additional use cases, advocacy, and expansion by connecting customer priorities to the value Immuta can deliver.Contribute to regional customer success playbooks, best practices, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that improve scale and consistency across EMEA.EXPERIENCE REQUIREDExperience: 5–8 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solution Delivery, consulting, or a related customer-facing role within enterprise SaaS, cloud, or data-focused environments.Enterprise Customer Success: Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.Regional Expertise: Experience working with customers across multiple EMEA countries and an understanding of the region’s diverse business and regulatory environments.Technical Skills: Working knowledge of modern data ecosystems and cloud platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, Starburst, AWS, Azure, or GCP.Data Governance: Familiarity with data governance, data privacy, security, access control, GDPR, and data residency concepts.Strategic Account Management: Ability to develop success plans, interpret customer health and usage Profisee is a growing Microsoft top-tier partner focused on data management solutions in general and, more specifically, in the area of Master Data Management.Reporting to our Chief Customer Officer, the Customer Success Manager (Hybrid London, UK Based) will be responsible for helping existing customers maximize their usage of Profisee’s Master Data Management (MDM) Platform, resulting in customer retention, expanded deployments, and enthusiastic customers helping to promote Profisee.In coordination with various value-added resellers (VARs), you will manage approximately 50-60 enterprise software accounts that span different customer segments (strategic, develop, sustain), that are in different points in their customer journey are using Profisee under different license models (SaaS, subscription and perpetual) and deployment models (SaaS, Platform-as-a-Service within the customer’s cloud tenant, IaaS within the customer’s cloud tenant, and on-premise). title: Customer Experience Manager - Dutch or Swedish Speaking
description:

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.Location: London, the UK or Lisbon, PortugalAbout The DepartmentRenewals Account Managers, Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.What You’ll DoThe Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. Acting as both a trusted business advisor and a commercial owner of the account, you will build strategic relationships with stakeholders to clearly articulate ROI and business value and ultimately successfully close renewals maximizing upsells and minimizing churn. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Lifecycle & SuccessManage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal. Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion. Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs. Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews. Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services. Commercial & RenewalsYou are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast. Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives. You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value. Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets. Cross-Functional & Operational ManagementDevelop and maintain long-term relationships with stakeholders in your account portfolio. Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing and other teams to resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals. Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams. Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time. AI CompetenciesGenerative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries. Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities. Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts. AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward. QualificationsFluency in English AND Dutch or Swedish (written and spoken).Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales. 2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred. Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications. Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure. Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus. Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales. Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions. CompensationFor Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €50,000 - €69,000.The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.EquityThis role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.What Makes Cloudflare Special?We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. title: Client Solutions Manager - GBS
description:
ResponsibilitiesThe Global Agency and Accounts (GA&A) team works with leading agency groups and multinational advertisers, acting as a strategic and consultative partner. We establish and lead the partnerships that turn TikTok's integrated suite of products into solutions that build businesses and brands.We solve complex, cross-market growth challenges for some of TikTok's largest global advertisers, bringing together strategy, platform expertise, and tailored solutions to meet high-impact business goals.You will turn those partnerships into scalable programs and product adoption, accelerating measurable outcomes for clients and driving revenue growth for TikTok.The Client Solutions Manager (CSM) will work closely with the sales team to provide support and expertise in meeting client objectives and providing best in class customer service to internal and external clients. This team member will work across multiple lines of business within the Amazon portfolio and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in the org, including Sales Ops, Product, Measurement, and Creative Solutions.The CSM will be responsible for negotiating, managing, and optimizing complex opportunities spanning the full marketing funnel. They will use data and analytics to build consultative solutions for our clients. They will establish and strengthen key client relationships with a focus on driving revenue, advertiser education & advertiser satisfaction. Success in this position requires a passion for delivering best in class client service, ability to navigate cross-functional programs and projects, and skill in on-the-ground execution.Responsibilities- Partner with Brand Partnerships Managers and the Team Lead to manage and grow relationships with our advertisers- Serve as the primary liaison between clients and agency partners, ensuring seamless communication, aligned objectives, and joint accountability across campaign planning, execution, and post-campaign review- Spearhead the development and implementation of plans, measurement solutions, and reporting across both performance campaigns and custom programs/sponsorships- Manage inventory booking and presale pipeline, reporting, and opportunity accuracy in CRM platform- Recommend optimization strategies and monitor implementation and execution to exceed KPIs and advance learning agendas- Identify and present insights on product usage and aggregated data to accelerate client business and drive incremental revenue growth through upsell conversations- Build trusted relationships as an external product consultant educating partners on new TikTok features, product solutions, and best practices to scale industry knowledge and drive education- Demonstrate a proactive approach to troubleshooting and problem solving through proper escalation channelsQualificationsMinimum Qualification(s)- Minimum 5+ years of experience in account management/media services roles in digital marketing or ad tech.- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across multiple businesses, cross-functional teams, and geographies.- Strong project management skills with experience prioritizing and managing tasks within a fast-paced environment. Comfortable running status meetings, managing action items, and keeping everyone updated on status of all associated projects/programs. Able to manage the expectations of internal and external stakeholders.- Proven track record in CRM-driven pipeline management and forecasting discipline, with consistent opportunity logging and data hygiene to meet quarterly revenue targets.- Ability to analyze data and identify insights using datasets from our Ads Manager platform and Brand Lift Studies.- Experience diagnosing and solving technical problems with product and engineering teams.Preferred Qualification(s)- Experience in auction-based ad environments and managing social platform clients is a plus.- Passion for data and technology - leverage data to drive strategy and measure success; comfort with technology to understand what drives product adoption and influence the product roadmap.- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates flexibility and is quick to adapt to changes.- Understanding of entertainment distribution models across theatrical release windows, premium video-on-demand (PVOD), and subscription streaming platforms (SVOD/AVOD).- Experience in performance marketing, lower-funnel campaign management, or conversion-driven advertising solutions is a plus.About TikTokTikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​Why Join UsInspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​​Diversity & Inclusion​TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Ekco🚀 Founded in 2016, Ekco has quickly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing cloud solution providers and your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider.IT leaders choose Ekco to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk – powered by local expertise, delivered at European scale.We specialise in helping organisations advance their cloud maturity guiding transformation, strengthening security, and maximising the value of their technology investments.☁️ In simple terms: we help organisations modernise with confidence securing their systems, optimising their cloud, and keeping them resilient in a rapidly changing world.🌍 Today, we’re a thriving team of 1,000+ talented and supportive colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Benelux, South Africa, and Malaysia—and we’re continuing to grow.At Ekco, How We Work Matters As Much As What We Deliver. Our People Live By Four Core Values That Shape Everything We Do:On It: We take ownership, follow through, and get things done.All In : We collaborate, support each other, and commit fully to shared goals.Connected: We build trusted relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.Hungry to Grow: We stay curious, keep learning, and push ourselves to the next level.🏠If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home here.The RoleDay-to-day At Ekco:The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the relationship for every customer in one of Ekco's Flex pods, at every tier, and is their trusted advisor. You work alongside the Technical Account Manager who covers the pod and the Account Manager, and you are the named deputy for another Flex pod's customers. A Tier 1 or Tier 2 customer in the Aligned pod is also assigned to a Senior Customer Success Manager, agreed by the Director of Customer Success. The Pod Leader owns the pod and, with you, its SLAs: the Pod Leader is accountable for delivery and you for the customer's view of them. You own the customer: their outcomes, the governance around them, and their view of Ekco as a partner rather than a supplier.Ekco meets every contractual commitment, and you make sure it does. The conversation you lead goes further: for customers in the cloud it is about service requests, efficiency, FinOps and how their estate evolves; for customers still mainly on-premises it is about running well today and planning the next step. Either way, your job is to make sure each customer gets the most from the service they buy and to move them up the maturity scale. The TAM owns the cloud score and the cloud steps agreed with the customer.Day-to-day At Ekco:Own the customer outcomes for each assigned account: agree with the customer what success looks like, capture it in the customer's cSIP, and review progress against it at the cadence set by the customer's tier.Accountable for the overall health of assigned accounts, using the pod's service performance data alongside customer sentiment, adoption and commercial signals, and making sure contractual commitments are honoured.Build relationships from operational contacts to executive sponsor, so the scope of the service, the deliverables and the customer's business priorities are fully understood.Make sure each new customer has the handbook, contacts and escalation routes at the start of service, and record them in the customer's Customer Service Record.Keep each customer's Customer Service Record current: the named deputy, the agreed cadence, and whether the customer has a named TAM or the Technical Account Management team.Lead service reviews and business reviews, at the cadence set by the customer's tier and with the Account Manager owning the commercial content, that focus on outcomes, adoption, cost and roadmap, with the pod's service performance as one input rather than the whole agenda.Own relationship NPS and the feedback loop for assigned accounts; ticket CSAT sits with the Pod Leader. Aim for a net positive NPS, act on the written feedback rather than the score alone, and close the loop with the customer.Own customer complaints for your accounts, with the Pod Leader responsible for the pod's part in resolving them.Own customer management escalation, levels 3 and 4 in the Managed Services Handbook, with the Pod Leader. The Pod Leader owns operational escalation of tickets and incidents, levels 1 and 2.During a P1 or major incident, keep the customer's senior stakeholders informed in working hours and lead the follow-up. The major incident manager sends the initial notification and the hourly 24x7 updates.Work alongside projects team to ensure new services are introduced effectively, focusing on appropriate monitoring, metrics and support in place.Keep account documentation current and in the correct location, including the cSIP, meeting minutes and agreed actions.Keep the customer's risk register with the TAM, who advises on technical risk.Lead the Get to Green plan where an account is at red, working with the Pod Leader and TAM, and close it against agreed exit criteria.Make sure contractual service reporting reaches the customer on time and in the agreed format, drawn from standard Ekco dashboards rather than built by hand.Manage the service performance of third parties procured for the customer. Commercial terms and resale renewals stay with the Account Manager.Keep customer contacts and service data current in CRM.Own revenue assurance for your accounts: contract equals delivered equals billed, including the monthly billing reconciliation, with Finance consulted. Resolve billing queries.Present the system audit and asset reports the TAM or pod produce from Ekco tooling, for renewals, upgrades, Cyber Essentials Plus and stock.Monitor account health through the Customer Health Index to spot churn risk early, and lead the Get to Green plan with the Pod Leader when an account turns red.Working effectively across more than one supply channels (eg internal, client, 3rd party suppliers and partners).Assess each customer's maturity, using the product adoption map you prepare with the Account Manager and the TAM's technical findings, agree the next step with the customer, and build it into the cSIP and the customer's education plan, prioritising the changes that most reduce demand on the service desk and most improve the customer's experience. The TAM scores the cloud position and owns the cloud steps; you record the next cloud step the TAM agrees with the customer in the cSIP.For cloud customers, lead the conversation on service requests, efficiency and FinOps, with the TAM leading on the technical detail. For customers still mainly on-premises, keep availability and incident governance tight while planning the next step.Drive service adoption: make sure each customer uses everything their service offers, including Ekco Connect, Ekco's customer service portal, and self-service, automated requests, reporting and the features in their contract, and that the right people know how to use them. Work with the TAM, who drives the technical adoption of Ekco best practice and reference architectures.Keep each customer's tier current and raise tier changes with the Director of Customer Success.Act as the named deputy for another Flex pod's customers during leave and absence, and coach Customer Success Managers on the path to the senior role. Before planned leave, hand over any open escalation, Get to Green plan or renewal to your deputy.Take your turn on the expanded out-of-hours roster of Pod Leaders and Senior CSMs, acting as major incident manager and duty manager. Escalation above the roster goes to the normal escalation chain.Act as the customer's voice inside Ekco, feeding their feedback and future needs into the pod, Professional Services, and product and service development.Work as one team with your Pod Leader and TAM. The Pod Leader owns the pod and, with you, its SLAs, the TAM owns the technical roadmap, and you own the customer.What we are looking for: Proven experience in a service delivery, customer success or account management role within the IT industry, preferably with Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience, demonstrating proficiency in owning customer relationships and optimising client outcomes Working knowledge of cloud, security and managed services, including cloud consumption and FinOps principles, enough to hold a credible roadmap conversation with a customer's IT leadership. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, team members, and stakeholders across all organizational levels. A customer-centric mindset, dedicated to delivering exceptional service and ensuring client satisfaction. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to anticipate and address customer needs and concerns proactively. A successful track record in a Customer Service environment, showcasing the ability to manage customer accounts and work with the team that delivers against service level agreements. Strong understanding of account management principles, including the ability to develop and maintain productive client relationships while driving business growth and retention. ITIL Foundation (desirable) Be able to interpret contractual commitments and service levels, and explain them clearly to the customer, using ITIL good practice. Experience in a wide variety of information technology fields to fully understand the details of the services that can be provided. Commercial awareness: how renewals, contract value and cost-to-serve connect to the customer's outcomes. Confident using data (health scores, dashboards, ticket trends) to tell a customer a clear story about their service and what comes next. Excellent delegation skills, negotiation skills and the ability to coach a junior colleague and to lead without line authority across the pod, TAMs and specialist teams.Benefits / Perks ☀️ Time Off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays 🎂 Birthday Leave: One extra day off to celebrate 💰 Company Pension Scheme ❤️Health Care 📞 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for wellbeing support 🏃‍♀️ EkcOlympics: Global team activity challenges 📚 Unlimited access to Pluralsight for continuous development 🌱 Real opportunities to grow, including international progressionWhy Ekco🏅 Company of the year 2026 Tech Excellence Awards⭐️ Microsoft’s 2023 Rising Star Security Partner of the Year🚀 First Irish Microsoft MSP to achieve all four Microsoft Security Specializations🌈 A culture rooted in diversity, equality, inclusion & belonging🎉 A commitment to internal mobility and career progression✨ Flexible, family-friendly working at the heart of our culture🔐 Proud to be your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider chosen by IT leaders to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk.

description:

As a senior member of the Customer Value Management team, you'll also mentor colleagues and improve how we deliver value.What You'll DoDevelop deep knowledge of Mimecast's product suite, including Email Threat Protection, Human Risk Management (HRM), Insider Risk (Code42), and DMARC Analyzer, to drive adoption and feature utilization.Lead technical onboarding, deployment health reviews, and platform optimization. resolution.Partner with Sales and Renewals to support retention and expansion, and with Professional Services and Support to deliver a consistent customer experience.Bring customer insights and feedback to senior stakeholders across Customer Value Management, Product, and Support.Mentor Customer Value Managers and improve success frameworks, playbooks, and ways of working to help the team retention, and expansion outcomes.Proficiency with Gainsight or an equivalent platform for health scoring, risk management, and playbook execution, plus working knowledge of Salesforce.Strong analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to learn new technology and use data to guide decisions.Ability to travel approximately 15% to support strategic accounts.Preferred QualificationsSaaS experience in cybersecurity, particularly with Mimecast, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, or comparable email security or Human Risk Management platforms.CompTIA Security+, CISSP (Associate or full), CEH, or vendor-specific certifications aligned to email or cloud security.Familiarity with FINRA, HIPAA, FCA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.Ability to interpret API logs, review connector health, and diagnose integration issues without first-level escalation.Experience mentoring customer-facing colleagues, and a background in strategic account management or a comparable advisory discipline.The base salary range for this position is £60,000−£90,000 plus benefits. description:

title: CMC Program Lead TLX597 & TLX66
description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.See Yourself at TelixThe CMC Program Lead for TLX597 &TLX66 is responsible for leading the CMC Sub-Team and serving as the single point of contact for all CMC topics on the program matrix for early-stage antibody-conjugate radiopharmaceutical diagnostic and therapeutic assets developed under a co-development collaboration. The CMC Lead will develop, execute, and maintain the integrated CMC strategy and plan grounded in Quality by Design (QbD) principles, aligned to Stage-Gate requirements, spanning Drug Substance, Drug Product, Analytical Development, and Supply Chain from preclinical development through phase 3. As the cross-functional integrator, the CMC Lead is the accountable owner for all CMC deliverables, establishing relationships with functional SMEs, internal manufacturing sites, and external partners to drive alignment, decision documentation, risk management, and Stage-Gate readiness. This position is part of the CMC Programs team within the Radiopharmaceutical Development group in Global Operations.Key AccountabilitiesDevelop, own, and execute CMC strategies for antibody-based radiopharmaceutical drug candidates across the TLX597 &TLX66portfolio, from preclinical development through clinical supply. Apply QbD principles (target product profile, critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, control strategy) to drive science-based CMC development aligned to Stage-Gate expectations and readiness criteriaServe as the single point of accountability and key point of contact for all CMC matters within the TLX597 &TLX66program matrix. Lead the CMC Sub-Team and represent the CMC function within the broader program governance structure, ensuring all CMC questions, decisions, and deliverables are coordinated through a single accountable ownerLead the CMC Sub-Team for assigned programs, coordinating functional SMEs across Drug Substance (antibody/bioconjugate), Drug Product (radiochemistry/fill-finish), Analytical Development, QC, QA, Supply Chain, Validation, and Regulatory CMC across multiple Telix sites. In partnership with SMEs, own cross-functional integration and ensure CMC development activities are executed following QbD principles and sound scientific rationaleOwn and maintain the integrated CMC plan, risk register, decision log, and project dashboards for assigned programs, ensuring CMC timelines, budgets, and deliverables are traceable to Stage-Gate requirementsTrack CMC deliverables across multiple concurrent targets. Maintain relationships with internal and external partners, including contract management, budgeting, invoice approval, and ensuring CMC timelines are integrated with overall program plans and Gate-readiness milestonesProactively identify CMC risks and develop mitigation strategies. Escalate issues early, not when timelines are already at risk. Prepare Gate-readiness packages with documented evidence of deliverable completion, open risks, and residual risk rationaleProvide regular CMC updates to senior management and program governance on project status, timelines, risks, Stage-Gate readiness, and resource forecastingCoordinate with internal manufacturing sites and external CDMOs/CMOs for Drug Substance and Drug Product supply. Serve as CMC relationship lead for key partner management, ensuring delivery to contract, specification, and timelinePartner with internal Telix stakeholders (R&D/Discovery, Translational Development, Radiochemistry, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain) and collaboration partner counterparts to manage cross-functional dependencies and critical path activities across preclinical, translational development, coordination of CMC IND package, and clinical supply workstreams.Enable development of CMC technology transfer packages and handoff documentation to enable transitions between development phasesFacilitate team meetings using project management best practices/tools to drive cross-functional communication, timely and effective decision making, and successful execution of project objectives.Organize and maintain CMC team communications including meeting agendas, minutes, decision logs, task lists, and risk analyses/mitigation strategies.Identify gaps in processes, then work with appropriate parties to develop and implement solutions.Consistently perform duties within established SOPs, and in accordance with GxP requirements, where applicable.Education And ExperienceBA or BS degree in Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline required10+ years of relevant radiopharmaceutical/pharmaceutical/biopharma CMC experience with 5+ years of CMC program/project management experience. Experience with biologics (monoclonal antibodies, bioconjugates) and/or radiopharmaceuticals is required.Experience managing pharmaceutical alliance/partnership programs or multi-site CMC execution within a matrix operating model, with demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional integration and escalation within defined governance structuresExcellent communication, collaboration, and change management skillsRobust knowledge of FDA and global regulatory requirements (IND, NDA/BLA) applicable to radiopharmaceuticals and biologics. Technical understanding of antibody manufacturing (upstream/downstream processing), bioconjugation, radiochemistry, and drug product fill/finish. Familiarity with ICH Q8-Q12 guidelines and Quality by Design (QbD) principles, including target product profile (TPP), critical quality attributes (CQAs), critical process parameters (CPPs), and control strategy developmentMust have strong experience in project management across drug development lifecycle.Strong foundational collaboration skills with experience working in a successful matrix managed environment.Ability to demonstrate initiative, suggest improvements to current systems as well as establish new processesAble to thrive in a highly dynamic, fast paced, continuously changing global environment with minimal oversight/direction.Ability to travel to manage collaborations with global team members and CDMOs (minimal).Key CapabilitiesCommitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you doResults-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable resultsCreativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challengesStrong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise languageCollaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goalsResilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challengesInclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respectedAdaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challengesEthical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholdersContinuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skillsAt Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination title: Senior Project Manager
description:
At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food. From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.The OpportunityOur Technology team have exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Project Manager where you will take ownership of large-scale critical projects driving the delivery of the programmes from site completion, operational readiness, migration and the implementation of automated mechanisation.As the integration lead you will ensure collaboration and connectivity between the business, technology, engineering, operations, suppliers and delivery partners to ensure everything comes together safely on time and with clear accountability.What You'll Be DoingReporting to the Senior Head of Programme Integration, you will:Own the integrated delivery plans, driving milestones, dependencies, risks, critical path and outcomes.Lead site completion, readiness, migration, cutover, testing, training and go-live.Integrate technology, WMS, engineering and mechanisation delivery into the wider programme.Provide clear governance, reporting and escalation to senior stakeholders.Coordinate multiple teams, suppliers and delivery partners, holding to accountable for desired outcomes.Drive safe, controlled implementation through stabilisation, handover and benefits realisation.Ensure delivery is controlled across time, cost, quality, risk and change.Support the Senior Head of Programme Integration with any additional tasks.What We're Looking ForTo be successful in your application you will be a confident project leader, someone who thrives in connecting operations, technology, engineering and suppliers’ teams with an objective focused and curious mindset. You will be able to demonstrate a proven track record in:Leading complex, cross-functional projects and implementations, ideally within a 3PL, logistics & supply chain, or FMCG environment.Experienced in migration, cutover and business continuity planning.Knowledgeable in WMS, automation, technology or engineering integration.Strong project controls across RAID, planning, cost, change, dependencies and governance.Comfortable managing suppliers and senior stakeholders with confidence.Able to turn complex delivery challenges into clear actions and outcomes.Certified in PRINCE2, APM, Agile or similar qualifications are desirable.This is a hands-on delivery leadership role where your ability to bring people, technology and operations together will directly shape successful implementation. If you are an experienced delivery leader who brings structure, pace and accountability we would like to hear from you!Role DetailsSalary: Up to £81,000 per annum (DOE)Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.Location: This role can be based anywhere in the UK, however individuals must be comfortable with travel across the UK.What’s in it for you?As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)Discounted rates on healthcare cash planAttractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectivesAuto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailersAccess to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance ProgrammeA first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and developmentCycle to work schemeWhy Gist?When you join Gist, you're joining a business that plays a critical role within the M&S Group.You'll have the opportunity to influence meaningful change, work alongside experienced leaders and contribute to one of the UK's leading food supply chains.Our culture is built around our values of being Progressive, Accountable, Collaborative and Ethical, creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to grow.Whether you're leading a site operation, delivering transformation or shaping future strategy, your work will make a real difference.Our commitment to inclusionAt Gist, we believe our differences make us stronger.We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know. We'll work with you to ensure you have the support you need.

title: Staff Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager - Confluent
description:
IntroductionIBM’s Trust and Security Confluent organization is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That's the power of data in motion in action — giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At IBM , we're building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure.The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of IBM's Trust and Security Confluent organization. Its mission is to earn and retain trust by championing Confluent's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance positions, thereby accelerating customer adoption and use of our platform and products.OCISO is building a Global Product Regulatory Compliance team: a new function that determines which laws, regulations, and industry frameworks apply to Confluent's products, translates them into product and platform controls, and gives customers, regulators, and our field teams clear and consistent answers. The program covers direct obligations, such as the EU GDPR, Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and indirect obligations that flow down from customers in financial services, healthcare, the public sector, telecommunications, and other regulated industries. Coverage spans cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy, sovereignty, AI governance, and third-party risk management.Your Role And ResponsibilitiesAs Staff Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager you will operate on a global scale, so you will develop relationships with OCISO team members in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and partner closely with IBM's Regulatory Compliance, Legal, and Government & Regulatory Affairs teams. Organizational, interpersonal and communication skills are key to success.We are looking for a motivated, high energy senior individual contributor who can own and successfully execute with minimal oversight. This is a senior role with real influence and accountability. The right person is able to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously, enjoys doing in-depth regulatory research and analysis, and hands on work, executing deliverables personally, rather than coordinating others. The successful candidate will thrive in ambiguity, is adept at context switching, and comfortable with fluid execution priorities. Heavy AI usage is expected.Regulatory Compliance ResponsibilitiesRegulatory Analysis — Review regulatory texts, supervisory guidance, and industry frameworks and best practices. Determine the impact to Confluent's products, and produce clear applicability and impact assessments that state what applies, why, and what it requires of the product. Serve as the subject matter expert on key global regulatory requirements.Control Posture Assessments — Conduct risk-based posture assessments against priority obligations such as EU DORA and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Document findings and propose control enhancements or feature build outs to Product or Engineering owners for inclusion in their roadmaps. Influence Product Strategy — Work directly with Product Managers and Engineering leads to translate regulatory requirements into concrete technical, operational, and product controls. Draft business requirements for product enhancements, and contribute to pre-launch reviews so new products and features meet mandatory controls before general availability.Regulated Industry & Field Support — Support OCISO customer-facing leads on flow-down obligations from financial services, public sector, and healthcare customers, under frameworks such as SEC Reg SCI, FFIEC, HIPAA, FedRAMP, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, EU AI Act, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Turn recurring customer questions into standard, reusable positions.Audits, Examinations & Incident Notifications — Prepare evidence, documentation, and technical responses for regulatory audits and examinations touching Confluent products (for example, under DORA), coordinated through IBM.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Senior Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy — Engage as a peer with senior leaders across Confluent Product, Engineering, Trust & Security, GRC, and with IBM Legal, Regulatory Compliance, and Government & Regulatory Affairs. Privacy Compliance ResponsibilitiesPrivacy compliance program - Operationalize a global privacy compliance program from the ground up. Support new privacy and sovereignty rule implementation, maintain a global rule inventory, map privacy obligations across applicable regimes to documented controls, and complete product PIAs, DPIAs, and IBM’s information governance processes.Global Privacy SME - Serve as a global privacy expert, providing advisory guidance on privacy rules and regulations, responding to Product questions and assessing new product launches through a privacy control lens. Influence Product Strategy - Work directly with Product Managers and Engineering leads to translate regulatory requirements into concrete technical, operational, and product controls. Draft business requirements for privacy and sovereignty-related product enhancements, and contribute to pre-launch reviews so new products and features meet mandatory controls before general availability.Customer notifications - Manage customer cyber incident response notifications in partnership with IBM enterprise teams. Privacy certifications - Complete and maintain certifications such as the Data Privacy Framework and ISO/IEC 27701.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Senior Stakeholder Engagement & Advocacy — Engage as a peer with senior leaders across Confluent Product, Engineering, Trust & Security, and GRC teams, and with IBM Legal, Compliance, and Government & Regulatory Affairs. Preferred EducationMaster's DegreeRequired Technical And Professional ExpertiseMinimum of 12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, information security, privacy, or technology risk roles, ideally within a cloud/SaaS provider, a major technology vendor, or a highly regulated enterprise.Strong issue-spotting judgment: you can read a regulation or supervisory guidance you have not seen before, pinpoint the provisions that matter for a cloud and software platform, and distinguish what can be resolved through control mapping from what needs legal interpretation.Strong, current knowledge of global frameworks affecting cloud products across cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy, and AI governance, such as DORA, NIS2, GDPR, the EU AI Act, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act, as well as sector-specific regimes such as those impacting financial services.Privacy expertise in GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws, or ISO/IEC 27701, and cross-border transfer mechanisms such as the Data Privacy Framework, and the difference between controller and processor obligations, with particular depth on processors.Experience with hands-on assessments. You have written DPIAs and PIAs and are technically fluent. You understand data flows, retention, encryption, access controls, and subprocessors well enough to test an engineer’s answer.Proven experience mapping regulatory requirements to control frameworks (for example, NIST 800-53) and turning them into concrete technical and operational controls with Product and Engineering teams.A working understanding of cloud-native architecture.Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp brief for executives, a precise requirement for engineers, and a defensible regulatory position, and you are comfortable presenting to, and respectfully challenging, senior leaders as a peer.A track record of hands-on delivery as a senior individual contributor: you personally produce the analyses, mappings, evidence packages, and enablement content, and drive them to completion without a team to delegate to.Judgment under ambiguity. You can build a program from an ad hoc starting point, and take a practical approach prioritized by risk and market exposure.Preferred Technical And Professional ExperienceDirect experience with financial services regulators and supervisory expectations, such as PRA, FCA, BaFin, OCC, FFIEC, SEC Reg SCI, MAS, APRA, RBI, or SEBI, including outsourcing and ICT third-party risk requirements.Familiarity with AI/ML security and governance considerations, including evolving regulatory expectations for AI in cloud environments.Experience with healthcare, public sector, telecommunications, or data sovereignty regimes, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, the UK Telecommunications (Security) Act, SecNumCloud, or EUCS.Experience working within or alongside a hyperscaler or large technology vendor, navigating shared or inherited compliance obligations between a parent company and a product line.Experience using AI tools to accelerate regulatory research, horizon scanning, and control mapping, with the rigor to validate AI-generated output before it reaches customers or regulators.A law degree.An IAPP credential such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, or CIPT.

Please note that to be considered for this role you must have the right to work in this location. AI Adoption and Value: Turns AI potential into prioritized use cases, adoption in the field, and validated value. Data and Insight: Builds metrics and dashboards that leaders trust and act on. Initiative Governance: Runs portfolios, decision logs, and escalations that keep leadership aligned and accountable. Discretion and Judgment: Trusted with confidential information and sensitive organizational dynamics. Regional Facilities Manager, Gosport HampshireCompany description:BJF Group is a leading multidiscipline Main Contractor based across the UK, specialising in delivering high quality construction projects across various sectors priding ourselves of our reputation for excellence and attention to detail.Within our Facilities Management division, the Southwest Core team plays a crucial role in the day-to-day delivery of reactive and preventative works across a diverse range of properties and systems within our client's sites - as a Facilities Management . Within the team, you will be expected to provide comprehensive repairs and maintenance to a range of commercial instillations.Position:The Regional Facilities Manager will manage the day-to-day contractual and operational delivery ensuring contractual compliance is achieved within the areas under their responsibility in line with BJF Group policy and procedures. To be a point of contact for the client facilities management team to provide technical support and advice to achieve contract delivery.Expected to provide leadership, management, and development of the contract, ensuring financial and operational commitments are met and exceeded.Role Responsibilities for the Regional Facilities Manager :Contract Health and SafetyOperational Delivery of Contract to conclude reactive and small works using clients CAFM system. Data Management & AdministrationSite ManagementEmployee Management & LeadershipStakeholder ManagementLed statutory and mandatory compliance assurance across a multi-site estate, identifying compliance risks, implementing mitigation strategies, and escalating critical issues to senior leadership. Developed and implemented continuous improvement processes for maintenance delivery, driving enhanced service performance and supplier accountability. Managed supply chain performance against contractual KPIs, resolving underperformance and ensuring timely submission of compliance documentation through CAFM systems. Directed asset identification and maintenance strategy development to support effective planned maintenance programmes and long-term asset management. Delivered commercial growth through identification and development of additional services, projects, and chargeable works opportunities, increasing contract value and profitability. Provided technical leadership and specialist advice to clients and project teams, supporting the successful delivery of small works and estate improvement projects. Acted as the primary interface for audits, compliance reviews, and governance activities, ensuring robust contract management and adherence to contractual obligations. Developed and monitored contract financial plans, driving revenue growth, cost control, reduction of WIP and debt, and achievement of profit targets. Produced and presented operational, technical, and performance reports to senior stakeholders, supporting strategic decision-making and client engagement. Led health, safety, and compliance assurance activities, including audits, risk management processes, incident reporting, and implementation of control measures across the contract portfolio. Requirements of the Regional Facilities Manager:Hold an industry recognised H&S management qualification (IOSH or SMSTS)Hold an industry recognised based qualification i.e., City & Guilds / NVQ or similar in an appropriate engineering subject. Managerial experience at Contract Manager or Senior Supervisor level within technical and or hard services is essential. Practical experience must include recruitment and line management/supervisory experience. Other information:Competitive SalaryAnnual Leave Entitlement: 33 days per annum (inclusive of bank holidays)Group Pension Scheme: Provided by Royal London to save for your future. Free Eyesight test: SpecsaversCompany Funded Health Cash Plan: helping you spread the cost of essential healthcare like, trips to the dentist. Remote GP Access: speedy access to a GP by telephone or online plus electronic prescriptions24/7 EAP Service: free advice, counselling and support for you and your family whenever you need it. Discounted Gym Membership at more than 3,000 gyms across the UK. Better BJF Initiative: wellbeing and mental health champions readily available at work. Employee Referral Scheme: recommend a personal connection to us and claim a cash reward for their successful hireWe are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their sex; religious or similar philosophical beliefs; political opinion; race; age; sexual orientation; or, whether they are married or are in a civil partnership; or, whether they are disabled; or whether they have undergone, are undergoing or intend to undergo gender reassignment.

title: Senior Strategic Planning Manager (@one Alliance)
description:

We're transforming the way water is managed for future generations.The East of England is one of the most water-stressed regions in the UK. Population growth, climate change, environmental pressures and increasing customer expectations are driving the need for unprecedented investment and innovation. As we prepare for AMP8 delivery and shape the future of AMP9, we're looking for an exceptional Senior Strategic Planning Manager to help lead this transformation.This is a unique opportunity to operate at executive level, influencing strategic decision-making across one of the UK's largest and most ambitious infrastructure programmes.The RoleReporting directly to the Alliance Director, you will act as the critical link between the Integrated Main Works Alliance and Anglian Water, ensuring strategic priorities, regulatory commitments and delivery performance remain fully aligned.You’ll lead strategic planning, governance, performance assurance and executive reporting activities, providing insight that enables informed decision-making across the Alliance. Working closely with senior leaders, partner organisations and client stakeholders, you'll help drive business performance, manage strategic risks and support the development of Anglian Water's future investment programme, including contributions to the PR29 Business Plan.This is a highly visible leadership position requiring a blend of strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, operational understanding and commercial awareness.What You'll Be DoingStrategic LeadershipLead strategic planning and business performance activities across the Alliance. Ensure clear alignment between client priorities, regulatory obligations and delivery outcomes. Support the Alliance Director and Executive Leadership Team in developing and implementing long-term strategy. Provide executive-level insight, challenge and recommendations to inform key business decisions. Drive governance frameworks and assurance processes that support excellence in delivery. Performance & Programme AssuranceOversee the monitoring and reporting of Price Control Deliverables (PCDs). Analyse business performance, forecast future risks and identify opportunities across a 2-3 year horizon. Develop robust programme assurance processes covering time, cost and quality. Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and supported by effective governance. Stakeholder ManagementAct as the principal strategic interface between the Alliance and Anglian Water. Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and delivery partners. Provide clear visibility of performance, emerging risks and future priorities. Represent the Alliance in executive forums and key strategic discussions. Transformation & Continuous ImprovementSupport the transition from AMP8 into AMP9 delivery. Help shape organisational transformation initiatives across the Alliance. Embed lessons learned, client feedback and best practice into business planning and performance improvement. Champion innovation, sustainability and environmental stewardship across programmes. What We're Looking ForWe're seeking an experienced strategic leader who thrives in complex, collaborative environments and can influence at the highest levels.Essential ExperienceSignificant leadership experience within programme delivery, business management, strategic planning or performance management. Experience operating within complex infrastructure, utilities, engineering, construction or regulated industries. Strong track record of executive reporting, governance and performance assurance. Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills. Ability to turn complex data into meaningful strategic insight. Strong commercial and financial acumen. Outstanding communication, leadership and relationship-building skills. Desirable ExperienceWater industry experience and knowledge of AMP delivery. Understanding of regulatory performance frameworks and Price Control Deliverables (PCDs). Experience working within alliance, joint venture or collaborative delivery models. Degree qualified and/or professionally accredited in Business Management, Programme Management, Engineering, Leadership or related disciplines. MSP, APM, PRINCE2, MBA, Chartered Status or equivalent qualifications. We are pioneering new ways of working, challenging traditional delivery models and making a lasting impact on the environment and communities we serve.Apply today to make difference to your career and the region we serve.About UsWe develop intelligent solutions using our award-winning integrated planning and design approach to deliver functional infrastructure and lasting environmental and social legacies. We create new possibilities for humanity through our innovative approach to delivery.Together with our clients, we are always striving to find a smarter way to deliver projects. WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO AVOID MISSING OUT ON THIS OPPORTUNITY.Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment. title: Senior Project Manager - Water
description:
Package: Salary up to £75,000 (DOE) + Share Scheme + EV Car Scheme + Bonus + Pension + Private Healthcare + Benefits.Actemium Automation Hampshire is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of projects for customers across the water and wastewater industry. This is an opportunity for a confident project leader with experience in automation, control systems or industrial engineering to manage complex projects and build strong customer relationships.Working closely with customers and our engineering, commercial and delivery teams, you will oversee projects from initial definition through to commissioning and handover. You will help ensure projects are delivered safely, to specification and within agreed timescales and budgets.About The RoleAs Senior Project Manager, you will take overall responsibility for the planning, coordination and delivery of assigned projects. You will lead project teams, manage customer expectations and provide clear oversight of project performance, risks and commercial outcomes.You will support the continued development of Actemium Automation Hampshire’s water industry business by delivering high-quality solutions and fostering long-term customer partnerships.Key ResponsibilitiesProject DeliveryLead projects from initiation and planning through design, build, installation, commissioning and handover. Develop and maintain project plans, programmes, budgets and resource forecasts. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and suppliers to meet project requirements. Monitor progress against scope, schedule, cost and quality objectives, taking corrective action where needed. Ensure project documentation, progress reports and records are accurate and kept up to date. Manage project changes and ensure their programme, cost and delivery impacts are understood and agreed. Customer & Stakeholder ManagementBuild and maintain effective working relationships with customers and key stakeholders. Act as the principal point of contact for assigned projects, providing clear and timely updates. Understand customer requirements and ensure they are communicated to the project team. Manage expectations, resolve issues and support positive customer outcomes. Work collaboratively with other project partners, contractors and suppliers. Commercial & Risk ManagementManage project budgets, costs, forecasts and financial performance. Identify, assess and manage project risks, opportunities and dependencies. Support tender reviews, contract administration and commercial negotiations. Monitor scope and contractual obligations, escalating issues appropriately. Work with commercial and finance teams to support accurate reporting and timely invoicing. Leadership & CollaborationProvide clear direction and support to project team members. Promote effective communication and collaboration across engineering, operational and commercial teams. Support resource planning and identify skills or capacity requirements. Share lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement in project delivery. Represent Actemium Automation Hampshire professionally with customers and industry partners. Quality, Safety & ComplianceEnsure projects are delivered in accordance with company procedures, customer requirements and applicable standards. Promote a positive health, safety, quality and environmental culture. Ensure project risks and safe systems of work are considered throughout delivery. Support quality assurance, testing, commissioning and handover activities. Ensure project teams maintain appropriate records and comply with relevant site and industry requirements. About YouEssential RequirementsProven experience managing complex engineering or automation projects from start to finish. Significant experience working in the water or wastewater sector delivering complex projects. Knowledge of industrial automation, control systems or electrical engineering project delivery. Strong understanding of project planning, budget management, risk control and reporting. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors and suppliers. Excellent customer communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage project scope and change. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Proficiency with project planning and reporting tools. DesirableA degree, HNC or HND in engineering, project management or a related discipline. A recognised project management qualification, such as PRINCE2 or APM. Experience delivering projects for water companies or their delivery partners. Familiarity with PLC, SCADA, telemetry, instrumentation or control system projects. Knowledge of relevant water industry standards, frameworks and site requirements. Experience supporting commissioning and operational handover. Personal AttributesProactive, accountable and focused on delivering results. A clear and confident communicator who builds trust with customers and colleagues. Practical and solution-oriented when managing challenges. Calm and decisive when working to deadlines or changing priorities. Collaborative, approachable and committed to developing effective teams. Committed to high standards of safety, quality and customer service. Why Join Actemium Automation Hampshire?Lead projects that support essential water and wastewater services. Work with experienced engineering and project delivery teams. Contribute to the delivery of automation solutions for a vital industry. Be part of Actemium and VINCI Energies, a global network focused on industrial and energy solutions. Access opportunities for professional development and career progression. If you are an experienced project leader who is passionate about delivering successful engineering projects in the water industry, we’d love to hear from you.
