title: Product Manager
description:
As a trusted partner, our Public Health mission is to make food systems safer, healthier and more sustainable. Throughout our global network in 27 countries, we offer to our customers a wide range of testing and innovative solutions dedicated to preventing health risks related to food, environment and consumer goods. External growth has been a key pillar of our history with more than 40 acquisitions completed in the last 10 years.If you want to contribute to an inspiring long-term purpose, to be part of a fast growing company on a high-value market with significant build-up opportunities, and to grow in an entrepreneurial and warm environment, join us! Northern Europe Cluster Industry Product Manager We are looking for a Northern Europe Cluster Industry Product Manager to support and grow the industry portfolio across the Pharma Quality Control and Food Safety & Quality markets. This role sits at the intersection of science, marketing and business strategy, transforming market insights into commercial actions that drive portfolio growth and customer value across the Northern Europe Cluster.Working closely with local commercial teams, regional stakeholders and global product management teams, the Industry Product Manager will support portfolio performance, market development and customer engagement activities. The role requires a balance of scientific knowledge, commercial awareness and strategic thinking, enabling informed decisions around product positioning, pricing, lifecycle management and business opportunities.Reporting into the Northern Europe Cluster Marketing organisation, the Industry Product Manager will collaborate extensively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Application Specialists and Global Product Management teams. This is a field-based role with regular travel across the Northern Europe Cluster and France, providing direct exposure to customers, laboratories, industry events and key stakeholders.What will your responsibilities be?  Manage the Industry portfolio throughout the product lifecycle, from launch and market introduction through to phase-out and end-of-life activities.  Monitor portfolio performance, identifying growth opportunities and supporting actions to improve business results and market penetration.  Support pricing strategy development and pricing policy recommendations, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives and market conditions.  Contribute to portfolio positioning, value proposition development and deployment of strategic marketing initiatives across the region.  Gather, analyse and interpret market, competitive, customer and regulatory intelligence to support business decisions and commercial strategy.  Monitor industry trends, customer needs and competitor activities, identifying opportunities and risks impacting portfolio performance.  Provide market insights and recommendations to marketing and commercial teams to support business planning and growth initiatives.  Support annual budgeting, forecasting and business review processes, contributing to performance analysis and demand planning activities.  Partner with commercial teams to provide product expertise, technical support and tactical guidance during customer engagements.  Participate in customer visits, laboratory visits and strategic account discussions to better understand market needs and strengthen customer relationships.  Gather customer feedback and communicate market requirements to regional and global product management teams.  Build relationships with industry influencers, key opinion leaders and strategic stakeholders across the pharmaceutical and food sectors.  Support the development and execution of the Marketing Action Plan, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.  Contribute to the creation of customer-facing materials, product training content and promotional activities.  Plan, organise and participate in congresses, exhibitions, demonstrations, workshops and user meetings to support awareness and demand generation.  Collaborate effectively across local, regional and global functions to ensure successful execution of portfolio and marketing initiatives. Who are you?  Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Science or a related scientific discipline.  Strong understanding of industrial microbiology, quality control processes and laboratory environments within the pharmaceutical, food or related industries.  Experience in product management, marketing, sales, business development or another customer-facing B2B role is advantageous.  Commercially aware, with confidence analysing portfolio performance, pricing strategies, forecasts and business opportunities.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate market intelligence and data into actionable recommendations.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both technical and commercial audiences.  Ability to influence stakeholders and drive collaboration across multiple functions without direct authority.  Customer-focused, proactive and results-oriented, with a strong commitment to delivering business growth and customer value.  Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.  Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; experience with CRM systems and commercial reporting tools is beneficial.  Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.  Willingness to travel extensively (30%+ of working time) across the Northern Europe Cluster and France.  Comfortable working within an international, matrix organisation and collaborating with diverse regional and global stakeholders. Why join us? This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, marketing and commercial strategy while supporting a diverse portfolio across the pharmaceutical and food industries. You will gain broad exposure to international stakeholders, product lifecycle management, customer engagement activities, strategic marketing initiatives and business development projects, while contributing directly to the growth of bioMérieux's Industry business across the Northern Europe Cluster.
